plan.change: Integrate the five tested v69 audit fixes into Staging and revalidate the deployed build.
expectedChanges: Check size on the persisted compact representation; preserve the entire original state and backward-compatible saves.
Make durable saves use scoped IndexedDB storage, preserving existing Staging records and ensuring an isolated equivalent publication path cannot reset them.
Advance recall observation and delegated supply exactly once, and derive generation store summaries from actual dated trade relationships.
ownerDecisions: 2026-11-27 user authorized Staging deployment and revalidation of the local candidate. No production deployment.
hqDecisions: Keep schema compatibility, test with untouched audit files in separate profiles, scope to AmberTime and keep historic backups intact.
manualChecks: Test both real stopping saves across the blocked month, compare restored finance/inventory/identity and transactions, and verify both independent path stores.
Test transaction failure and concurrent activity, generation reporting and delegated refill observation.
plan.rollback: Revert the Staging integration while preserving scoped IndexedDB and legacy backup bytes. Export current progress before any reader downgrade.
outOfScope: Production, other works, game economics, new features and P2 cosmetics.
unverified: Physical iPhone Safari and X browser, published environment, and fresh 100-year confirmation until independently observed.
alternativesRejected: Removing save validation or rewriting historic data.
Publishing to production before the new Staging verification.
boundaryCases: Historical supported v8 and v9 records; same-origin different path; tabs competing for same key; transaction failure or interruption; save/replay near a handoff; repeated fills and dealer introductions.
testPlan: Run focused market, storage and recall tests and check normal UI continuation/restoration using both audit assets.
Review exact local diff against lock and separate verified desktop tests from pending device/endurance checks.
plan.problem: Ordinary play stops after 32 or 48 years; two deployment paths share data; current saves bypass IDB; supply and generation summaries diverge from actual player actions.
plan.currentContract: v69 local session methods contain a compact record, support older saves and assume a coherent post-save operation/game snapshot.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Current cap runs on expanded history, origins share a key, and observer/summary semantics miss real events.
plan.design: Limit the actual persistent payload, isolate and safely migrate writes by installation, keep atomic save and recall semantics, and report relationships by their true creation month.
plan.migration: Copy legacy staging state through validation and isolate it from the production path. Preserve old raw data for recovery and explicit import.
plan.compatibility: Preserve stored barrel IDs, balance, PCG state, delivered counts, release and recall history, generation handoff and formal supported imports.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging only. Public production release requires separate approval.
